teamSignal.note: Team strength moves this forecast: the win chance comes from a team rating that weights margin of victory, tested on 4,281 past games it had never seen (2006–2021) — log loss 0.629 against 0.642 for our previous rating and 0.610 for the sportsbooks' own odds. It has not been shown to beat the sportsbook market.

winProbability.calibration: From the margin-of-victory Elo win head, published exactly as evaluated on held-out 2006–2021 — no shrink toward 50% is applied, and no claim to out-predict the sportsbook market is made.

marketComparison.note: The sportsbook numbers are the books' own, shown for context. A difference is a difference — this model is not validated to out-predict the sportsbook market.
